entities.summary: Sa Dingding is a Chinese folk singer and songwriter. Her ethnicity is Han Chinese, and she has Mongol ancestry, a mixed descent of Han Chinese and Mongol, and sings in languages including Mandarin Chinese, English, Standard Tibetan, as well as an imaginary self-created language to evoke emotions in her songs. She also plays traditional instruments such as the guzheng and morin khuur.
